observed_gap: isCommandMessage only inspects last user content when it is a string
handleCommand independently applies the same string-only extraction
OpenAI-compatible chat content may be an array/object of text parts
therefore a local management command encoded as text parts is not intercepted and proceeds into the ordinary provider route
security_relevance: Commands may contain local credentials, especially `$qwen-api account add <JWT_TOKEN> [COOKIE]`. A non-string content shape can therefore forward command text intended for the local proxy to Qwen upstream.

candidate_fix.rule: use one local content extractor for both command detection and command parsing; detect prefix only at start with a whitespace/end boundary
candidate_fix.fail_closed_note: If unusual multipart splitting changes command arguments, local command failure is safer than forwarding credential-bearing command text upstream.

required_regression: string, array-of-text-parts and object-text forms of `$qwen-api account add SENTINEL` must all be intercepted locally; ordinary text mentioning `$qwen-api` mid-sentence must not execute
limits: Sentinel token only; no real credential used
No product file changed by INTEGRATION_HELPER
No provider/Notion traffic, hosted CI, Cloudflare, Windows, production or account mutation
